hooks.command: CFG="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"; if [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ]; then [ -f "$CFG/skills/component-first/SKILL.md" ] || echo 'WARNING: the spoke-kit skills are not installed in this cloud session. Plugins do not install in the cloud; the environment setup script copies them from ../ecology/plugins/spoke-kit into ~/.claude.'; else grep -sq '"ecology"' "$CFG/settings.json" "$CFG/plugins/known_marketplaces.json" || echo 'WARNING: the ecology plugin marketplace is not installed — component-first enforcement and the spoke skills are OFF. Accept the plugin install prompt, or run: claude plugin marketplace add esassoc/ecology && enable spoke-kit@ecology via /plugin.'; fi
